Two gummies a day with sugar and glucose syrup, from a brand I've never heard of, at £19.99 a jar when I'm used to waiting for Boots 3-for-2. I'd want to see it at a proper discount before I'd even think about paying full whack.

I'm not convinced a gummy will do anything for my tiredness, and I've never bought magnesium, so I'd want to see the lab results and how much sugar is in each serving before paying £25 a month. The 30 to 60 day wait before it 'works' also puts me off.

I've never heard of Mëva and there are no reviews I can find, and I already spent money on magnesium last year that did nothing for me. I'm careful with money now, so I'm not paying £24.99 for a brand I know nothing about.

Gummies still feel like sweets to me, the sort of thing you give children, and I'd rather take a tablet for something I'm doing for my health. The sugar and glucose syrup put me off too, even with the magnesium.

I already take a plain vitamin D from Boots and it does the job. Gummies with sugar and glucose syrup feel more like a sweet than a supplement, and I'm not paying nearly twenty pounds a jar for that when I'm watching what I eat anyway.
